# Home dashboard

A dark wall-panel dashboard built from [posters](/cards/entity-card#poster): one entity each, the icon and its pills on top, a large value at the bottom. Three [heading cards](/cards/heading-card) open it: the title with today's date and a clock, who is home and what is playing, and a row of pills to the other views. Below them a [layout card](/cards/layout-card) puts the posters four across (two on a phone): the temperatures outside and in three rooms in a [swipe card](/cards/swipe-card) (swipe or tap a dot), the power with its history, the robot vacuum with its own buttons, the TV, the front door to hold, the car, the fan, the thermostat, the dining light with its slider, the blinds and the kitchen speaker. The last cell stacks the [rain card](/cards/rain-card)'s animated field over a tile of today's energy and its cost. Every control works: tap, drag and hold.

<DashboardGrid mode="dark" b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Home
      subtitle: "{{ now().strftime('%A, %e %B') }}"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", show_icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: subtitle
      badge_style: outline
      badge_size: l
      badges_position: inline
      badges:
        - { entity: person.alex, show_entity_picture: true, show_name: true, rules: &home [{ state: home, color: green, label: Home }, { state: not_home, color: grey, label: Away }] }
        - { entity: person.sam, show_entity_picture: true, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: person.kim, show_name: true, rules: *home }
        - { entity: media_player.living_room_tv, name: TV, icon: mdi:television-play, attribute: media_title, show_name: true, visibility: [{ condition: state, entity: media_player.living_room_tv, state: playing }] }
        - { entity: group.downstairs_lights, name: Lights on, visual: count, show_name: true, color: amber }
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: subtitle
      badge_size: l
      badges_position: inline
      tap_action: { action: none }
      badges:
        - { value: Home, icon: mdi:view-dashboard-outline, style: filled }
        - { value: Lights, icon: mdi:lightbulb-group-outline, style: outline, tap_action: { action: navigate, navigation_path: /dashboard-home/lights } }
        - { value: Climate, icon: mdi:thermostat, style: outline, tap_action: { action: navigate, navigation_path: /dashboard-home/climate } }
        - { value: Energy, icon: mdi:lightning-bolt-outline, style: outline, tap_action: { action: navigate, navigation_path: /dashboard-home/energy } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:swipe-card-pro
          per_page: 1
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.outdoor_temperature
              name: Outside
              layout: poster
              icon: mdi:weather-partly-cloudy
              decimals: 1
              rules: &temperature
                - { below: 5, color: blue, label: Cold }
                - { below: 20, color: teal, label: Mild }
                - { below: 25, color: green, label: Comfortable }
                - { above: 25, color: orange, label: Warm }
              badges:
                - { entity: sensor.outdoor_humidity, icon: mdi:water-percent }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
              name: Living room
              layout: poster
              icon: mdi:sofa
              decimals: 1
              rules: *temperature
              badges:
                - { entity: sensor.living_room_humidity, icon: mdi:water-percent }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.bedroom_temperature
              name: Bedroom
              layout: poster
              icon: mdi:bed
              decimals: 1
              rules: *temperature
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.office_temperature
              name: Office
              layout: poster
              icon: mdi:desk
              decimals: 1
              rules: *temperature
              badges:
                - { entity: sensor.office_co2, icon: mdi:molecule-co2 }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.power_consumption
          name: Power
          layout: poster
          visual: sparkline
          hours_to_show: 12
          rules:
            - { below: 1000, color: green, icon: mdi:flash-outline, label: Low }
            - { below: 3000, color: amber, icon: mdi:flash, label: Normal }
            - { above: 3000, color: red, icon: mdi:flash-alert, label: High }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: vacuum.robot
          name: Robot
          layout: poster
          control: buttons
          control_options:
            - { icon: mdi:play, action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: vacuum.start, target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot } } }
            - { icon: mdi:home-import-outline, action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: vacuum.return_to_base, target: { entity_id: vacuum.robot } } }
          rules:
            - { state: cleaning, color: teal }
            - { state: docked, color: grey }
          badges:
            - { entity: sensor.robot_battery, visual: ring }
            - sensor.robot_current_room
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: media_player.living_room_tv
          name: Living room TV
          layout: poster
          icon: mdi:television-play
          attribute: media_title
          control: buttons
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: deep-purple, label: Playing }
            - { state: paused, color: grey, label: Paused }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: lock.front_door
          name: Front door
          layout: poster
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: locked, color: green, icon: mdi:shield-lock }
            - { state: unlocked, color: red, icon: mdi:shield-lock-open }
          badges:
            - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }
                - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: sensor.ev_battery
          name: Car
          icon: mdi:car-electric
          layout: poster
          rules:
            - { below: 20, color: red, label: Low }
            - { above: 20, color: green }
          badges:
            - entity: binary_sensor.ev_plugged
              rules:
                - { state: "on", color: green, icon: mdi:power-plug, label: Plugged in }
                - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:power-plug-off, label: Unplugged }
            - sensor.ev_range
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: fan.living_room
          name: Living room fan
          layout: poster
          attribute: percentage
          unit: "%"
          control: segments
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: cyan }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: climate.living_room
          name: Living room
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_temperature
          unit: °C
          decimals: 1
          control: stepper
          color: deep-orange
          badges:
            - entity: climate.living_room
              attribute: hvac_action
              rules:
                - { state: heating, color: deep-orange, icon: mdi:fire, label: Heating }
                - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:fire-off, label: Idle }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining table
          layout: poster
          value: "{{ (state_attr('light.dining_table', 'brightness') | float(0) / 2.55) | round }}"
          unit: "%"
          control: auto
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber }
            - { state: "off", color: grey }
          badges:
            - { entity: group.downstairs_lights, visual: count, color: amber }
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:blinds-horizontal
          layout: poster
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          control: slider
          color: indigo
        - type: custom:entity-card-pro
          entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
          name: Kitchen speaker
          layout: poster
          icon: mdi:speaker
          attribute: media_title
          control: buttons
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: green, label: Playing }
            - { state: idle, color: grey, label: Idle }
        - type: custom:layout-card-pro
          rows: [1fr, auto]
          view_layout: { span: [1, 3] }
          cards:
            - type: custom:rain-card-pro
              entity: sensor.rain_rate_roof
              today: sensor.rain_today
              name: Rain
              visual: flow
              rules:
                - { below: 2.5, color: light-blue, label: Light rain }
                - { above: 2.5, color: blue, label: Moderate rain }
            - type: custom:entity-card-pro
              entity: sensor.energy_today
              name: Energy today
              icon: mdi:cash
              decimals: 1
              secondary: "{{ (states('sensor.energy_today') | float(0) * states('sensor.electricity_price') | float(0)) | round(2) }} € at {{ states('sensor.electricity_price') }} €/kWh"
              color: green
```

</DashboardGrid>
